image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a single ripe fig. The fruit exhibits a pear-like shape with a broad base tapering toward a green stem at the top. The skin is textured with a mix of deep purple and brownish hues, speckled with small yellow dots (lenticels). At the bottom center, the ostiole (eye) is visible as a small, dark reddish opening. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green, suggesting foliage. There is a faint watermark text in the bottom right corner.
